trace.final:
Done. Here's what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: Deployment history showed v2.3.1 (latest) was unhealthy in production, while v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release. Live status confirmed v2.3.1 failing in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** across all production regions.
3. **Verified**: Service is now healthy in all regions with error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident** (INC-0001, on-call paged) documenting the failure and rollback.

No approval was needed since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production. Recommended follow-up: investigate v2.3.1 before attempting any redeploy.
